title: 4. Preposition र Dependent Preposition-का नियम
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: समय, ठाउँ र दिशा जनाउने preposition, Task 1-का data preposition, block बनाएर कण्ठ गर्नुपर्ने dependent preposition, र ती सिधा-अनुवादका गल्तीहरू जसले लेखाइ बंगलादेशीको हो भनेर तुरुन्तै देखाउँछन्।

Preposition भनेका साना शब्दहरू हुन् (in, on, at, by, for, to, of, from, with), जसले अरू शब्दहरू समय, ठाउँ र दिशाका हिसाबले एकअर्कासँग कसरी जोडिएका छन् भनेर देखाउँछन्। हेर्दा सानो कुरा जस्तो लागे पनि यो परीक्षाका गल्तीहरूको ठूलो हिस्सा यहीँबाट आउँछ, र त्यसको कारण एउटै छ: preposition तर्कले होइन, pattern हेरेर कण्ठ गर्नुपर्छ। English-ले किन interested in भन्छ तर good at र afraid of भन्छ, त्यसको कुनै नियम छैन। यी fixed collocation हुन् — native कानलाई कि ठीक सुनिन्छन्, कि सुनिँदैनन्। बंगाली भाषीका लागि यो समस्या हो, किनभने तपाईंको स्वाभाविक बानी बंगालीको preposition सिधै अनुवाद गर्ने हुन्छ, तर बंगालीले यी सम्बन्धहरू फरक तरिकाले देखाउँछ।

Preposition कुनै noun वा pronoun-को अगाडि बस्छ र एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ: the book is on the table (ठाउँ), the meeting is at three (समय), she walked into the room (दिशा)। यसपछि आउने noun-लाई यसको object भनिन्छ। Tense अध्यायमा तपाईंले पहिल्यै देखिसकेको एउटा मुख्य नियम यहाँ फेरि आउँछ: preposition-पछि verb सधैं -ing form-मा आउँछ, कहिल्यै infinitive-मा होइन। Interested in studying, responsible for managing, capable of solving।
4.2 समयका preposition · in, on, at र यिनका छिमेकीहरू
समयका मुख्य ३ वटा preposition-ले “zooming in” तर्क मान्छन् — लामो समयदेखि बिस्तारै एकदम ठ्याक्कै बिन्दुसम्म।
महिना, वर्ष, ऋतु, शताब्दी, लामो अवधि
in July, in 2020, in winter, in the 1990s
on Monday, on 5 May, on weekdays
at 5 p.m., at night, at the weekend, at the start
IELTS-का लागि काम लाग्ने समयका अरू preposition:
since + सुरु भएको बिन्दु (present perfect-सँग आउँछ): since 2010, since January।
for + समयको लम्बाइ: for five years, for a decade।
during + एउटा अवधि (जब केही कुरा त्यही अवधिभित्र हुन्छ): during the 1990s, during the recession।
by + एउटा deadline (त्यसभन्दा ढिलो होइन): by 2030, by the end of the decade।
from … to / until + समयको फैलावट: from 2000 to 2010, until 2015।
In Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew since five years.
On Monday the shop is closed. / The population grew for five years.
in = कुनै ठाउँ वा क्षेत्रभित्र: in the room, in Dhaka, in the world।
on = कुनै सतह वा रेखामाथि: on the wall, on the coast, on the second floor।
at = कुनै निश्चित बिन्दु वा ठाउँमा: at the station, at the top, at home।
into / onto / to ले चाल वा दिशा देखाउँछन्: walk into the room, climb onto the roof, go to work।
The figures are shown in the chart, on the vertical axis, at the top of the page.
4.4 Task 1-का data preposition (fixed phrase-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्)
यी combination-हरूले graph-मा हुने उतारचढाव र परिमाण बताउँछन्। Writing Task 1-मा यिनमा कुनै छुट हुँदैन, र examiner-ले हरेक एकदम सही होस् भन्ने अपेक्षा गर्छन्।
Sales increased with 20 per cent and reached to a peak in June.
Sales increased by 20 per cent and reached a peak in June.
प्रतिशतका लागि “increase by”; अनि “reach a peak”-मा “reach”-पछि कुनै preposition आउँदैन।
एउटा बलियो Task 1 sentence-ले प्रायः यीमध्ये धेरैलाई एकैसाथ जोड्छ: The price rose by five dollars, from 20 to 25, reaching a peak of 25 in March.
धेरै verb, adjective र noun-पछि एउटा निश्चित preposition आउँछ। यसमा कुनै तर्क छैन; हरेकलाई एउटा unit-का रूपमा सिक्नुपर्छ। Block बनाएर कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्, र आफैं मुखमा नआउन्जेल प्रयोग गरिरहनुहोस्।
The policy resulted in higher costs.
The panel consists of five experts.
The essay focuses on two causes.
Families struggle to cope with rising costs.
Individuals are responsible for their choices.
People are more aware of the risks.
The system is capable of handling demand.
This trend is similar to the previous one.
Urban life is different from rural life.
He is good at solving problems.
The economy is dependent on exports.
The issue is related to poverty.
The course is suitable for beginners.
यी गल्तीहरू बंगालीको संरचना शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद गर्दा आउँछन्। यी एकदमै सामान्य छन् र examiner-ले देख्नेबित्तिकै चिन्छन्, त्यसैले यिनलाई सच्याउँदा छिटो र देखिने गरी accuracy बढ्छ।

discuss / enter / reach / marry ले सिधै object लिन्छन् — कुनै preposition चाहिँदैन
✗ discuss about the topic / enter into the room / reach to the destination / marry with her
✓ discuss the topic / enter the room / reach the destination / marry her

according to me / return back / comprise of / mention about / cope up with — यी गल्ती हुन्
✗ According to me / return back home / comprise of three parts / mention about it / cope up with
✓ In my opinion / return home / comprise three parts / mention it / cope with

Preposition-ले तपाईंको score-मा २ वटा ठाउँमा प्रष्ट असर गर्छ। Writing Task 1-मा data preposition-हरू (by, from, to, of, at) यति standard हुन्छन् कि एउटा गल्ती भए पनि तुरुन्तै accuracy error-का रूपमा आँखामा पर्छ। Writing Task 2 र Speaking-मा dependent preposition (depend on, lead to, responsible for, solution to) र सिधा-अनुवादका गल्तीहरू (discuss about, according to me) ले नियन्त्रित English-लाई अनियन्त्रित English-बाट छुट्याउँछन्। यी collocation भएकाले सही प्रयोग गर्दा तपाईंको Lexical Resource score पनि बढ्छ — अर्थात् फाइदा दोब्बर।

काम लाग्ने skill: Writing, Speaking
Task 1: Unemployment rose by four points, from six to ten per cent, before falling to eight in 2015.
Task 2: A lack of investment in public transport contributes to congestion and leads to higher emissions.
Speaking Part 3: It really depends on the situation, but on balance I think education is the solution to most of these problems.
अध्याय ४ सकियो, साथै मोड्युल १ पनि सकियो। अब मोड्युल २ (Band 7.0+ Complex Structures), अध्याय ५ आउँछ।

title: 4. Practice · Preposition र Dependent Preposition-का नियम
group: मोड्युल १ · शून्यदेखि दक्षतासम्म: आधारभूत Grammar Engine
blocks: धेरै verb, adjective र noun एउटा निश्चित preposition-सँग बाँधिएका हुन्छन्, र यो जोडीको पछाडि कुनै तर्क हुँदैन -- हरेकलाई एउटा fixed unit-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नैपर्छ: depend ON, responsible FOR, an increase IN।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** Dependent preposition पूरै कण्ठ गर्ने कुरा हो, तर academic writing-मा यी जताततै हुन्छन्; र बाँकी sentence बलियो भए पनि यहाँ गल्ती भयो भने त्यो basic error जस्तै देखिन्छ।
शब्दको प्रकार अनुसार block बनाएर सिक्नुहोस्
**Verb + preposition:** depend on, lead to, result in, result from।
**Adjective + preposition:** responsible for, interested in, aware of, capable of।
**Noun + preposition:** an increase/rise in, a reason for, a solution to, an effect/impact on।

यहाँ कुनै shortcut छैन -- हरेक जोडीलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै २ वटा शब्दका रूपमा होइन, एउटा chunk-का रूपमा कण्ठ गर्नुहोस्, र पूरा sentence-भित्र अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्, जबसम्म जोडी खोजेर निकाल्नुपर्ने नभई आफैं मनमा आउँदैन।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.1 · Preposition भरेर खाली ठाउँ पूरा गर्ने
blocks.instructions: हरेक खाली ठाउँमा सही preposition भर्नुहोस्। केही खाली ठाउँमा कुनै preposition आउँदैन; त्यस्तोमा (0) लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: The number of tourists rose ______ 20 per cent last year.
The figure grew ______ 5 million ______ 8 million ______ 2015.
Air pollution largely results ______ vehicle emissions.
The government should invest more ______ renewable energy.
She is very interested ______ studying abroad.
Rapid urbanisation has led ______ a housing shortage.

The success of the plan depends ______ adequate funding.
Many students suffer ______ a lack ______ confidence.
He is responsible ______ managing the entire department.
This problem is closely related ______ poverty.

items.reason: “discuss”-ले सिधै object लिन्छ, कुनै preposition चाहिँदैन।

items.prompt: There has been a sharp increase ______ demand ______ housing.
The committee consists ______ seven members.
The shop is closed ______ Fridays but open ______ the weekend.
Consumption fell ______ a low ______ five units in 2012.
Cities in the region rely heavily ______ agriculture.
The report focuses ______ the effects ______ climate change.
Please enter ______ the hall quietly. (direct object verb)

Students benefit greatly ______ regular feedback.
She applied ______ a scholarship ______ a British university.
A good education is the solution ______ many social problems.
The population has been rising steadily ______ 2000.

items.reason: “according to the chart” (यहाँ एउटा source जनाउँछ, त्यसैले यो सही हो)।

blocks: Recap · L1 (मातृभाषा) बाट अनुवादका trap-बाट बच्ने

Preposition-ले एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ -- ठाउँ, समय वा दिशा -- र यसको object यसपछि आउँछ। तपाईंको English अलिकति अनौठो लाग्छ भने, fixed English pattern प्रयोग गर्नुको सट्टा बंगालीको preposition pattern सिधै अनुवाद गर्नुभयो कि भनेर जाँच्नुहोस्।
**किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ:** बंगाली भाषीहरूका धेरैजसो preposition-का गल्ती English जोडीलाई आफ्नै fixed unit-का रूपमा नसिकी L1 को pattern शब्द-शब्द अनुवाद गर्दा आउँछन्।
Preposition कुनै noun वा pronoun-को अगाडि बस्छ र एउटा सम्बन्ध देखाउँछ: on the table (ठाउँ), at three (समय), into the room (दिशा)। यसपछि आउने noun-लाई यसको object भनिन्छ।

जब कुनै preposition-बारे पक्का हुनुहुन्न, बंगालीबाट सिधै अनुवाद गर्ने मोहमा नपर्नुहोस्। बरु पूरा fixed English phrase-लाई एउटा chunk-का रूपमा सम्झनुहोस् -- depend on, "depend from" वा "depend of" होइन -- किनभने English preposition विरलै बंगालीका preposition-सँग एक-एक गरी मेल खान्छन्।

blocks.title: Exercise 4.2 · L1 बाट सिधा अनुवादको गल्ती सच्याउने
blocks.instructions: हरेक sentence-मा बंगालीबाट सिधा अनुवादका कारण एउटा preposition-को गल्ती छ। हरेकलाई सही बनाएर फेरि लेख्नुहोस्।

items.prompt: According to me, the government should act quickly.
items.answer: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
accepted: In my opinion, the government should act quickly.
items.reason: आफ्नै विचार भन्न “according to me” गलत हो।

items.prompt: We discussed about the new policy for an hour.
items.answer: We discussed the new policy for an hour.
accepted: We discussed the new policy for an hour.

items.prompt: He entered into the classroom without knocking.
items.answer: He entered the classroom without knocking.
accepted: He entered the classroom without knocking.

items.answer: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.
accepted: The teacher emphasised the importance of grammar.

items.prompt: After the trip, they returned back to their village.
items.answer: After the trip, they returned to their village.
accepted: After the trip, they returned to their village.

items.answer: The report comprises five main sections.

items.answer: The essay mentioned three possible solutions.
